name: Security Incident Categories
command: # Incident types: Ransomware | Data Breach | Insider Threat | Phishing | Unauthorized Access | DoS/DDoS | APT
description: Common incident classification categories used during the Detection & Analysis phase to prioritize response effort and assign correct playbook.
notes:
Category → Typical severity & response:
• Ransomware — Critical; immediate isolation, offline backups, ransom policy.
• Data Breach — High/Critical; legal/compliance notification, forensics, data audit.
• Insider Threat — High; discreet investigation, preserve evidence before tipping off.
• Phishing/BEC — Medium; user remediation, credential reset, mail rule review.
• Unauthorized Access — High; scope how far pivot went, check lateral movement.
• DoS/DDoS — Varies; rate-limit/null-route, coordinate with ISP.
• APT/Long-term Intrusion — Critical; assume full network, extensive forensics.

Pyramid of Pain (hardest-to-replace IOC at top):
TTP > Tools > Network/Host Artefacts > Domain > IP > Hash

examples.label: Classify by observable indicators
examples.command: # Encrypted files + ransom note → Ransomware playbook; Sysmon Event 1 unusual parent → Code Execution playbook

examples.label: Severity matrix quick-ref
examples.command: # P1=Critical(data exfil/ransomware), P2=High(unauthorised access), P3=Med(phishing), P4=Low(policy violation)
